newsitem.title: USA: DynaGen in generic drug pact.
newsitem.headline: DynaGen in generic drug pact.

text.p: DynaGen Inc said Monday that it has established a strategic alliance with privately-held Kali Laboratories Inc to develop generic drug products.

Under the terms of the agreement, DynaGen will pay Kali Laboratories an undisclosed amount of cash and warrants to purchase DynaGen common stock over a period of five years in return for complete development of several specific generic drug products.
DynaGen said it will also be able to add new target brand name products to its development schedule as such opportunities are identified.

The company said that products developed under this agreement will be registered with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and manufactured by Able Laboratories, DynaGen's wholly-owned subsidiary in South Plainfield, New Jersey.
Work on three of the target products has already been initiated, the company said.
